title: A restaurant in Dubai
assumptions: A new mainland company opening a restaurant with staff and a fit-out.

items.name: Mainland company formation
items.agency: The emirate's economic department, under the federal Commercial Companies Law
items.quote: drafting a Memorandum of Association and local service agent agreement

items.name: Dubai trade licence
items.agency: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism
items.quote: investor can collect the business licence from service centres of the economic departments or through their websites.

items.name: Corporate tax and VAT registration
items.quote: All Taxable Persons (including Free Zone Persons) will be required to register for Corporate Tax and obtain a Corporate Tax Registration Number.

items.name: Employer registration
items.agency: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation
items.quote: employers may not recruit or employ any worker unless a work permit is issued in accordance with MoHRE procedures.

items.name: Premises zoning and lease
items.agency: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism; Dubai Land Department (Ejari); Dubai Municipality
items.quote: The business premises and location must comply with the requirements defined by the respective emirate’s Department of Economic Development

items.name: Food establishment approval
items.quote: Request for Layout Assessment for Food Establishment Licensing

mustNotInclude.name: Other emirates
mustNotInclude.why: Not in Abu Dhabi or Sharjah.
